findings.title: Reset-password still duplicates validation
findings.description: The `/api/auth/reset-password` endpoint has inline regex checks (`/[A-Z]/`, `/\d/`) and length validation identical to what was extracted into `lib/password-validation.ts`. It should import `validatePassword` to stay consistent with the change-password route and avoid future divergence.

findings.title: No test for retry failure scenario
findings.description: The retry logic has no automated test coverage. A test should simulate table update failures and verify: (1) retries are attempted with correct backoff timing, (2) the 500 error is returned after 3 failed attempts, (3) the error message correctly states that Auth was updated but table sync failed.

findings.title: Retry strategy undocumented
findings.description: The code comments say 'retry up to 3 times' but don't explain the exponential backoff formula (`Math.pow(2, attempt) * 100`). Future maintainers might not realize the delays are 100ms, 200ms, or why that timing was chosen. Add a comment: `// Exponential backoff: 100ms, 200ms before final attempt`.
